Predicates:
SummerOlympicGames(x) ::: x is a summer Olympic games.
HeldIn(x, y) ::: x was held in city y.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in event y.
Tokyo(y) ::: y is Tokyo.
Premises:
SummerOlympicGames(x) ::: x is a summer Olympic games.
HeldIn(x, Tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(x, Tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
¬HeldIn(x, Tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games were not in Tokyo.
